content_sections.heading: SVNIT Counselling Psychologist at a Glance

rows.details: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (SVNIT), Surat

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible and interested candidates must send the hard copy of their filled-in applications in the prescribed format through Speed Post to the following address: The Deputy Registrar (Establishment), Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Surat, Ichchhanath, Dumas Road, Keval Chowk, Surat, Gujarat-395007 The name of the post applied for should be superscribed on the envelope for sending the hard copy of the application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology/Clinical Psychology (Completed) with a minimum of one year of experience in providing counselling to students at educational institutes, hospitals, or mental health clinics. Desirable Qualifications: Experience in counselling adolescents aged 18 to 30 years, preferably in a residential institution, counselling centre, or psychiatric clinic. Ability to administer and interpret psychometric tests. Membership of professional societies is desirable. Age Limit: Up to 35 years. Candidates with higher desirable experience will be preferred. content_sections.heading: SVNIT Counselling Psychologist Job Description
content_sections.text: Individual Counselling & Psychological Support: Provide confidential, professional, one-to-one counselling services to students experiencing psychological, emotional, academic, social, behavioural, interpersonal, or personal concerns. Support students in managing stress, anxiety, depression, examination pressure, homesickness, adjustment difficulties, relationship concerns, grief, trauma, low self-esteem, loneliness, and other psychosocial challenges. Conduct psychological screening and assessments, develop individualized support plans, and provide follow-up and continuity of support. Crisis Intervention & Emergency Psychological Response: Provide timely psychological first-line support and crisis intervention in cases of acute emotional distress, suicidal ideation, self-harm risk, substance-use concerns, violence, harassment, trauma, or severe behavioural concerns. Undertake risk identification, safety planning, and intervention. Coordinate with Institute authorities, medical personnel, hostel administration, wardens, and emergency services while maintaining confidentiality. Mental Health Promotion, Awareness & Preventive Program: Design and conduct a structured calendar of mental health awareness, preventive, and wellness programs. Organize workshops, awareness campaigns, and interactive sessions. Conduct sensitization programs for students, faculty, staff, and other stakeholders to improve awareness and early identification of mental health concerns.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format. Duly attested copies of all certificates and mark-sheets. Appropriate conversion formula to percentage or CGPA/GPA calculator (in case of CGPA/GPA). All supporting documents, which must be self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of shortlisting followed by a personal interview. Shortlisting: The Institute will decide shortlisting parameters, and adequate numbers of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Fulfilling minimum qualifications and experience does not vest any right in a candidate for being called for an interview. Interview: Final selection is based on the performance of the candidate during a personal interview held at SVNIT Surat. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are notified for SVNIT Counselling Psychologist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 01 vacancy is notified, preferably for a female candidate.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to receive filled-in applications by Speed Post is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a completed M.A. or M.Sc. in Psychology or Clinical Psychology along with a minimum of one year of counselling experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 35 years as of the closing date for submission of applications, with preference given to candidates having higher desirable experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the remuneration offered for the Counselling Psychologist post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be paid ₹2,000/- per hour for a maximum of three hours per week based on services rendered.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application format and send the filled-in hard copy with attested certificates through Speed Post to The Deputy Registrar (Establishment) at SVNIT Surat.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting of candidates followed by a personal interview conducted at SVNIT Surat.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely on a visiting and contractual basis for one year, and claims for regular absorption will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. Are medical facilities or allowances provided under this engagement?
faq.answer: No, the appointee is not entitled to any medical facility, accommodation, or allowances other than the specified hourly remuneration.
